about_the_game:
Compete in the world of Cyber Pong City or dominate global leaderboards in Online Mode. Train and coach your AI player, improve their stats, and unlock powerful abilities to become a legend in this fast-paced, strategic sports adventure! 

Key Features

  • Dynamic AI Player Growth: Monitor your AI player's skills through match performance, tracked via metrics like Return Success Rate, Score Rate, Stamina Usage, Ability Usage, and Win Rate. Every match refines their DNA path, optimizing your coaching strategy.

  • Unique Player DNA: Our modified Q learning system allows for unique AI progression making each new player completely unique. Discover your champion, where every match is a stepping stone towards greatness.

  • Evolving Stats: Improve your player’s Speed, Stamina, Agility, and Aggression during training matches to prepare them to compete against higher ranked opponents. High Speed and Agility boost defensive returns, while Aggression fuels thrilling smashes for fast-paced matches. AI players evolve differently overtime.

  • Special Abilities: Defeat your opponent during training and there is a chance to learn their ability. Acquired abilities during training are Fire, Freeze, Bomb and Shield.  Each AI player controls ability usage based on their player DNA making for exciting match ups. 

  • Coaching Mechanics: Issue commands to your AI player realtime during the match and watch them respond,  some players will be more coachable than others.

  • Career Mode: Rise through the ranks in Cyber Pong City, earning Cyber Coins by winning tournaments and challenges. Use coins to recruit higher-ranked AI players, replacing your current one with stronger talent.

  • Cyber Pong Gyms: Challenge gym champions in each of the 10 different Cyber Pong City gyms and earn unique rewards and abilities after defeating each champion. 

  • Rank & Badge System: Climb from Bronze  to Legend rank. Defeat all 10 gym champions to become a Legend in CyberPong City.

  • Online Mode: Face off against players worldwide and conquer leaderboards to cement your legacy as a Cyber Pong Legend.

  • Dynamic World: CyberPong City players compete against themselves in local gyms , rival gyms matches or tournaments and are continually improving their skills.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-6100 or equivalent
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD Graphics 530 or better (integrated GPU OK)
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
